data.name: Khidhr
data.gender_notes: Khidhr is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Khidr is a figure in Islamic tradition who is considered a wise and just servant of God. He is known for his role as a guide and interpreter of divine will. The name Khidhr carries the meaning “The Wise One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Khidhr usually hope their child will grow to embody the wise one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes wisdom, guidance, and divine intervention in one's life.
data.etymology: Khidhr belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Wise One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khidhr total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_urdu.name: خضر

data.cultural_impact: Khidr holds an important place in Islamic literature, particularly in the "Qissat al-Khidr" (The Tale of Khidr), a story found in various religious texts, including the Quran and Hadith. He represents the concept of spiritual guidance, and his story serves as a reminder of the importance of patience and faith in the face of adversity. It also highlights the idea of trusting in God's plan and understanding that His ways may not always align with our human desires.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Khidr is viewed as a mystical figure, a wise man who possesses divine knowledge and understanding. He embodies the idea of seeking knowledge and wisdom to lead a truly righteous life. His story also illustrates the idea of accepting God's decree and that good may come from seemingly bad events. Khidr is considered a reminder of the importance of humility and trust in God, as well as the reality that true wisdom comes from a deep connection to the divine.
